packageRules.description: pnpm itself, pinned by packageManager in package.json and website/package.json: one PR that bumps both.
engines states what consumers of the published package need, not the toolchain this repo uses, so it's changed by hand.
The sibling libraries: one PR for both, as soon as they're published (pnpm-workspace.yaml exempts them from pnpm's one-day wait too).
